title: The promise requires another shift
notes: Verb card is VERB-2011-STARVE (storyboard); the edit plan said 2017 · STARVE. Storyboard wins.
Question Time is CARDS, not a clip: Kai's ruling on clip or card is still owed. If he picks the clip it replaces 11-09 to 11-11 (PAYSLIP, QT-1, QT-2) one for one at the same clock.
PAY card is DATA-PAY (2011–2017, per facts.md §15); it follows the Red Book's own paragraph 2.18 ('A two year pay freeze will be introduced from 2011-12…').

The plan's split screen (Bank left, Red Book right) under P7.19 is cut as two pictures in sequence here (Bank, then the Red Book cover), because the preview shows one picture at a time. In Premiere it may be built as a true split: Bank of England Facade left half on V1, the cover right half on V2.
Red Book title page (pdfpage002) stands in for 'one page' under the household line; the pay paragraph is saved for the pay line where it says exactly that.

Closing nurse: A Diary for Timothy (1945), the one shot that tilts up from a patient's bandaged foot and crutches to the full figures of an orderly, the patient on crutches and a nurse in cap and cape (shot bracketed by eye with grab strips: in ≈867.0, out ≈897.5; no shot log yet). src_in 884.3 starts mid-tilt so the nurse's full figure arrives about 6 s in, just before 'She was already there'. Hold 13 s to the end of the scene.
No credit string for A Diary for Timothy is given in footage.md (Crown copyright expired, picture only, tom@punchcard.tv upload); the end-credit string is owed.
